zh.introduction: 是腾讯文档《S11尊者玩法查询工具》的网页版，适配金铲铲「画之灵」返场。点选本局的尊者棋子即可找到对应组合与玩法。

features.title: 尊者组合查询
features.description: 选 2 个棋子通常即可锁定组合，并提示最能区分剩余组合的棋子。

features.title: 留言板
features.description: 玩家留言，管理员可回复、精选、删除。

features.title: 社区投稿
features.description: 玩家可登记未收录的新组合和玩法，管理员审核后公开。

features.title: 多管理员
features.description: 站长由安装参数创建，可在后台添加其他管理员，审核记录审核人。

en.introduction: is a web version of the S11 Exalted lookup spreadsheet for TFT / JCC Set 11 Inkborn Fables. Pick the Exalted units you see to find the combination and recommended lineups.

features.title: Exalted Lookup
features.description: Two units are usually enough to identify the combination.

features.title: Message Board
features.description: Players leave feedback; admins can reply, feature and delete.

features.title: Community Submissions
features.description: New combinations and lineups are published after admin review.

features.title: Multiple Admins
features.description: The owner account is created from install parameters and can add more admins.

source_evidence: Dockerfile (EXPOSE 8080, VOLUME /data, USER nonroot=65532, ENV ADDR/DATA_DIR)
